headline: G. Loverdos: Conditional openness to a fuel tax cut – What he said about the 13th and 14th pensions
summary: Greek Deputy Minister Loverdos said the government is conditionally open to a fuel tax cut and discussed the 13th and 14th pensions. He also said the Greece-Cyprus-Israel electricity interconnection will be completed.
why: Fuel taxes and pension payments are fiscal levers that affect Greek budget balances and government bond sentiment.
